question: Does the schema the working local pipeline produces restore on PostgreSQL 17, so the adapter layer can stay and only the image changes?

runs.verdict: invalid measurement: the supabase image does not give postgres DDL rights, so every statement failed

sample: function "email" already exists with same argument types
runs.verdict: the schema restores; every error is an object the supabase image seeds itself (auth, storage, vault, extensions, graphql, realtime, pgbouncer), not an incompatibility
every object lands and none is missing; the residual is a role the schema dump names but does not create, plus one --clean artefact
the graphql_public clean error is gone; the 119 role errors remain because that role is not in the source cluster's pg_roles even though the dump names it
confirmed: the working schema restores onto PostgreSQL 17 with every object present and no error

notYetMeasured: Provisioning a stack from a stored baseline instead of replaying the chain. The restore is proven; the applier has no baseline mode yet.
Behaviour under load on 17 (index plans, extension versions) - this record covers schema restore only.
conclusion: Confirmed: the schema the working pipeline produces restores onto supabase/postgres:17.11.0.018 with 260 of 260 objects, none missing and zero errors, once the restore runs as supabase_admin and the referenced roles exist first. The transition does not need the ~24 migrations the adapters replace rewritten; it needs baseline provisioning, after which the adapters can be retired and the pin moved.
evidence: artifacts pg17-baseline-probe-43029324112 (record pg17-baseline.json) and nightly run logs
rootCauses: restoring as postgres fails everything: that image gives it no DDL rights
the image seeds auth, storage, vault, extensions, graphql, realtime and pgbouncer, so a naive restore reports 172 already-exists errors
a schema-only dump carries no CREATE ROLE, and the role statements were originally joined without semicolons, so psql read them as one broken statement and created nothing
